title: S1 headroom and baseline noise criteria (cpfa arm only)
serves: M2 -> S1 -> RQ1. The noise line feeds prereg/S3_eval.json (G2, G3)
source: DESIGN.md 5.1, 6.1, 6.2 item 8, 6.3, 6.5, Table 8, Table 9 (R3, R4, R13); DECISIONS.md D-006, D-007, D-011, D-015, D-016, D-022, D-026, D-027; research/lu_papers_p2.md; research/applied_vs_not.md 4 P4, P5
input: results/real/runs.csv, rows with set = S1 only
role: S1 is a measurement, not a comparison. It routes the S2 tuning list (Table 8) and measures the noise line for S3. It makes no effect claim

table_8_verbatim.meaning: the map replaces a frequent choice

table_8_verbatim.action: round 2 stays as listed (it tests `q_map` first). Report the share

table_8_verbatim.meaning: time goes to searching. Better search places pay
time goes to travel. Far targets may cost score
table_8_verbatim.action: add the 3 m distance cap to round 3 in place of `spiral`

primary_metric.name: search_travel_ratio
primary_metric.formula: sum(search_s) / sum(travel_s) over the 30 runs of one distribution
primary_metric.why_primary: It is the only Table 8 reading whose action can change the S2 list. Both share_random rows keep round 2 as listed

routing_reading.name: share_random_pooled
routing_reading.formula: sum(share_random * n_departures) / sum(n_departures) over the 30 runs of one distribution
routing_reading.note: share_random includes fallback_random (D-016). In cpfa the map never fires, so fallback_random is 0

thresholds.comparison: point value of the pooled statistic, as Table 8 is written

primary_contrast: Each distribution's reading against the fixed Table 8 lines. No arm-vs-arm contrast exists in S1

action_rule.share_random: Reported per distribution. Either row keeps round 2 as listed, so the 3 distributions need no combination

search_travel_ratio.no_listed_action: otherwise (some value in 1.0 to < 2.0 and none < 1.0). Table 8 has no row for this band. None is added
search_travel_ratio.why_any: Round 3 is one list shared by all distributions. The S2 metric sums mean collected over the 3 distributions (DESIGN.md 6.3 item 6). So a travel-bound distribution enters the sum

noise_basis: Table 8 lines are routing lines fixed in DESIGN.md, not effect sizes. The 30-seed bootstrap interval of each reading is printed beside it. A reading whose interval crosses its line is flagged near_threshold. The action still follows the point value. The flag is reported, not decisive

interval_settings.note: Settings follow DESIGN.md 6.2 item 4. The bootstrap seed value is set here. numpy only (D-011)

noise_line_for_S3.statistic: sample standard deviation, ddof = 1, over 30 seeds

failure_condition.incomplete: any distribution with fewer than 30 runs that pass check_runs.py and have complete = 1. Then no sigma and no Table 8 reading for that distribution. Root-cause memo
failure_condition.zero_spread: sigma of collected = 0 in a distribution. The seed may not reach the simulation. Root-cause memo before S2
failure_condition.no_headroom: R3 (the map branch rarely fires) has no kill condition. A low share_random is reported, and the plan continues

round_1_rules_verbatim.evaluated_on: S2 round 1 (qmap at start values), not on S1. In cpfa, targets_reached_share is empty and fallback_random never fires

R4.risk: Far map targets lower a fixed-time count
R4.kill_or_switch: `targets_reached_share` < 50 % in round 1 → 3 m distance cap in round 3

R13.kill_or_switch: fallback share > 20 % in round 1 → `r_res` 0.5 m forced into round 2

open_for_S2_tuning_json: R13 fallback share has no denominator in DESIGN.md. Candidates: all departures, or map queries (branch map plus fallback_random). prereg/S2_tuning.json fixes it
R4 statistic over 30 round-1 runs (pooled or mean of runs) is not written in DESIGN.md. prereg/S2_tuning.json fixes it

reported_diagnostics.status: reported quantities only. No threshold, no verdict, no action
reported_diagnostics.why: The Grid-Based Complete Foraging Algorithm (GCFA) loses on Clustered. Adaptive Repulsive Pheromone Clustering (ARPC) loses on Powerlaw. The GCFA gain is in the collection tail. The ARPC gain timing is [CONFLICT] in its own paper. These readings show whether our 12 min runs contain those conditions

pickup_clustering_share.question: How often does a pickup happen near an earlier pickup?
pickup_clustering_share.input: points.csv rows with kind = pickup (schema v2, D-026), read through runs.csv columns (see needs_fields)
pickup_clustering_share.definition: share of pickups in a run with an earlier pickup in the same run, by any robot, at Euclidean distance <= 1.0 m
pickup_clustering_share.earlier: strictly smaller t_s. Equal t_s does not count as earlier
pickup_clustering_share.first_pickup: the first pickup of a run has no earlier pickup and counts as not near. It stays in the denominator
pickup_clustering_share.per: run, then mean, min and max over 30 seeds per distribution
pickup_clustering_share.reference: the random distribution value is the chance level for this arena and density
pickup_clustering_share.saturation_note: With k earlier pickups over about 97 m2, the chance share is about 1 - (1 - 3.14 / 97)^k. That is about 0.8 at k = 50. So late pickups are near on every layout, and the whole-run share may not separate the distributions

companion.name: pickup_near_prev_same_robot_share
companion.definition: share of pickups within 1.0 m of the same robot's previous pickup. A robot's first pickup counts as not near
companion.why: one earlier point per robot, so the chance level stays near 3 % and cannot saturate. Same pickup rows, one more runs.csv column

pickup_clustering_share.not_used: near_pickup_target_share (D-026) measures map targets near pickups. It is empty in cpfa, so S1 does not report it
needs_fields: points.csv pickup rows in the cpfa arm

late_phase_reading.question: Does the collection rate fall late in a 12 min run, more on Clustered than on Random?
late_phase_reading.input: runs.csv collected_4min, collected_8min, collected (schema v2, D-026, D-027)
late_phase_reading.per_distribution: drop = mean over 30 seeds of (mid - late)
late_phase_reading.contrast: drop(clustered) - drop(random), and drop(powerlaw) - drop(random), each with the interval_settings bootstrap over the seed index
late_phase_reading.why_minutes_0_to_4_skipped: minute 1 is a ramp-up from the nest, and pheromone use builds over time (research/applied_vs_not.md 4 P5)
late_phase_reading.pairing_note: distributions share seed numbers but not layouts. The bootstrap resamples the seed index of each distribution independently
late_phase_reading.reading_words: printed only. Interval above 0 reads as a late slowdown specific to that layout. Interval covering 0 reads as none. No action and no verdict follow (D-027)

turnover.definition: collected / 256 per run, mean, min and max per distribution
turnover.denominator_source: 256 resources always standing with respawn (DESIGN.md 2 F2-a, D-007, research/baseline_code_map.md FoodItemCount)
turnover.note: With respawn, the value can exceed 1. The standing count never falls, so this is turnover, not depletion
turnover.reference_marks_source: GCFA gain in the last 20 % and last 10 % [S-LP-1]. ARPC gain from 60 % or 80 % (p. 9) [S-LP-2], contradicted by its conclusion (p. 12) [CONFLICT]. research/lu_papers_p2.md Figure 1

source_rows.GCFA: research/lu_papers_p2.md 1.1: Clustered last 10 % is -14.69 %, and the stated cluster limit (PDF p. 7) [S-LP-1]
source_rows.ARPC: research/lu_papers_p2.md 1.3: Powerlaw last 10 % is -31.79 %, Cluster +12.78 % [S-IS-4]. Powerlaw limit (Section 6.2) [S-LP-2]

needs_fields.meaning: the two pickup clustering shares above, per run
needs_fields.why_not_existing: D-026 adds near_pickup_target_share, which is about map targets, not pickups. Every report number comes from runs.csv (DESIGN.md 6.5, D-013)

needs_fields.rows: kind = pickup rows in the cpfa arm (t_s, robot, x, y of the picked resource)
needs_fields.why_not_existing: D-015 makes points.csv header-only for cpfa. D-026 adds the kind column but does not say cpfa logs pickups. research/applied_vs_not.md 4 P4 still lists points.csv as header-only in cpfa

per_distribution: pickup clustering shares (when the fields exist)
swarm_level: action that fires per Table 8 row, by action_rule
output.records: this file path and its sha256 (rules/measurement.md 4.1)

seed_rules: Seeds 1001 to 1030 never touch the evaluation seeds 2001 to 2050 (DESIGN.md 6.1, D-022)
change_rule: Nothing here changes after the first S1 run. A needed change makes a new file and a new run set
